sentiment.model: fine-tuned RoBERTa (en) / XLM-R (other languages), int8 ONNX

negative_keywords.method: share of negative reviews mentioning each aspect phrase, kept when higher than in the other reviews; counts only, no significance test

distinctive_terms.method: Fightin' Words (Monroe et al. 2008), informative Dirichlet prior from 14 other productivity apps + this corpus; document-level counts; generic sentiment and filler words removed

drivers.method: L2 logistic regression, 1-2 vs 4-5 stars, aspect n-grams; C by 5-fold CV; 200 bootstraps, sign stability >= 0.9

complaint.name: App stability & crashes
complaint.definition: The app crashes, freezes, hangs or becomes unresponsive, on any platform. Not mere slowness (see performance) and not losing content (see data loss).

quotes.text: Great structure, but very glitchy to use.
^Title: Anytime I work on my project it just freezes.
Even after updating, uninstalling, and reinstalling, the app is doing absolutely nothing.

complaint.name: Updates & compatibility
complaint.definition: A recent update broke or worsened something, forced updates, OS version requirements, device compatibility.

quotes.text: idk if it's because I haven't updated it but im disappointed.
also why do i need 2gb free to update???
I have been through multiple is upgrades from 18 to 27 now and when Apple is getting better with upgrades notion is still in the same spot as it was before with no upgrades and only downgrades.

complaint.name: iPad-specific issues
complaint.definition: Problems that the review ties to the iPad app: iPad layout/landscape, Apple Pencil, Magic Keyboard / external keyboards, iPad-only bugs. Not generic iPhone problems.

quotes.text: I love notion but since my ipad is my primary device, it has made using the platform really annoying.
This is the main bug that annoys me about iPad, and that is why I won't be giving 5 stars.
I love notion but doesn't work on app.

complaint.name: Performance & loading speed
complaint.definition: Slow loading of pages or the app, lag, sluggish scrolling or responsiveness, heavy resource use or app size. Not crashes/freezes.

quotes.text: This is a great app but it is extremely laggy for me.... I use it via the web on my computer and the app on my phone and iPad but the response is super slow
I'd love to continue using this app but the slow animations make it feel clunky to use.

I open my phone for a morning meeting, go to notion to start AI notes and it just sits there... I'm on WiFi, and the app takes so long to load up it misses the first part of the meeting - often the MOST critical part!

complaint.name: iPhone / mobile app experience
complaint.definition: The iPhone or mobile app is worse than desktop: missing settings or features on mobile, mobile-only bugs, poor mobile usability. Not iPad-specific.

quotes.text: There are so many things entirely possible that I'd love for mobile to do, but it just can't.
I really want to love the mobile app too, but it just feels so clunky and misses important features that I'm used to on desktop, like a simple "my tasks" built-in view to match desktop.
Notion is great, but the mobile app is a mess of bugs and inconsistencies.

complaint.name: Typing & text editing
complaint.definition: Typing lag or jumping cursor, text deleted while typing, selection, copy-paste, formatting, emoji or keyboard input problems inside the editor.

quotes.text: Half the time I try to select and delete text, the pressing delete doesn't work.
For one, whenever I highlight a paragraph and try applying italic, or bold to it, it only applies to the first word and only allows me to edit that first word.
Sometimes it teleports your cursor somewhere else on the document so you type things in completely the wrong place.

complaint.name: Pricing & subscriptions
complaint.definition: Subscription price, paywalls, block/feature limits on the free plan, price increases, cancellation or refund problems. AI-specific pricing belongs to AI quality & limits.

quotes.text: I was using notion and it is a good tool for what I needed it for, but then all of a sudden one day my page was frozen behind a pay wall.
But - two major problems prevent it from being awesome - you can't upgrade your subscription!
Notion have continued to debit our account after I removed the subscription and deleted the account.

complaint.name: AI forced / intrusive
complaint.definition: AI features are pushed into the interface or workflow against the user's wish: AI buttons everywhere, cannot turn AI off, the app shifting focus to AI instead of core features.

quotes.text: It'd be really nice, but the AI ruins it.
Notion should remove the AI feature.
It was great before they put all their AI features front and center.

complaint.name: Missing features & feature bugs
complaint.definition: A specific feature is missing or broken (databases, images, embeds, calendar, widgets, export, colours...), or feature bloat. Use only when no more specific theme fits.

quotes.text: It's an app where most people will spend almost all their time reading, yet there is no way to make the text size larger - say if you happen to not still be in your 20s.
Insane for this team to not have that feature.
i can't color my text at all.

complaint.name: Account & login
complaint.definition: Cannot log in, sign-in or password-reset loops, being logged out, account access or workspace access problems.

quotes.text: it's nice but all of a sudden it stopped letting me in.

complaint.name: Data loss
complaint.definition: Notes, pages, text or edits disappear, get deleted or overwritten, or cannot be recovered.

quotes.text: None can be recovered after following trouble-shooting.
Transfer everything which loses history and maybe some associations.

complaint.name: AI quality & limits
complaint.definition: The AI itself disappoints: wrong or poor answers, usage/credit limits, AI being paywalled or too expensive, specific AI tools not working.

quotes.text: And no, it doesn't actually work like ChatGPT does.
The AI will help you fake who you want to be, and will keep you from growing into a better person.

complaint.name: Sync & offline access
complaint.definition: Content not syncing between devices, sync conflicts or delays, no or poor offline mode.

complaint.name: Customer support
complaint.definition: Support is unresponsive, unhelpful or hard to reach (human or bot).

complaint.name: Localisation & language support
complaint.definition: Missing interface languages, right-to-left (Arabic/Hebrew) text problems, poor support for non-English content.

complaint.name: UI / UX & usability
complaint.definition: The interface is confusing, cluttered, hard to navigate or unintuitive; design changes users dislike. Not the initial learning curve (see learning curve).

quotes.text: Please just let us be able to choose stuff like that instead of fundamentally changing how your app works on a whim, have hundreds of folders on notion I'm gunna have to transfer to a new app because of this

complaint.name: Learning curve & onboarding
complaint.definition: The app is hard to learn or get started with: steep learning curve, overwhelming at first, unclear how to begin, poor onboarding or guidance.

themes.method: Sentence-level themes from a human-approved taxonomy (data/themes.json); labels by Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8; impact = mean stars of reviews mentioning the theme minus the rest (Welch 95% CI)
